# Claude Design canvas: Meital Katzir broker profile

Live canvas (private until shared): https://claude.ai/artifact/JPqo3LJotmA7yNNuxMuUQr

Artboards: Main (Hebrew desktop, working deal filter), Mobile (full page), MobileFirst (first screen with the sticky bar), English (desktop, working deal filter), ListingCard (three states), ShareImage (1080x1350), BusinessCardFront and BusinessCardBack (1050x600).

These files are the canvas source (Design Components format, one .dc.html per artboard plus canvas.json). The WordPress page in ../broker-he.html and ../broker-en.html implements the same design responsively.

Illustrations stand in for photos until Meital's own images arrive; they depict no real property.
